Overview of Catalonia Region (Catalunya / Cataluña)

Catalonia Region (Catalunya / Cataluña) is located in the Catalonia region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Barcelona. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Sagrada Família, Park Güell & Casa Batlló, Barcelona Gothic Quarter & El Born, Girona medieval walls & Costa Brava, Montserrat Abbey & Tarragona Roman ruins.

RegionCatalonia
Capital cityBarcelona
Cities & municipalities98
Primary transport hubBarcelona Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Catalonia Region

Barcelona Sants high-speed hub (AVE/Iryo/Ouigo to Madrid, Girona, Figueres & France); Barcelona El Prat Airport (BCN). Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Catalonia

When visiting cities across Catalonia, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Pa amb tomàquet
  • Suquet de peix & Fideuà
  • Bombas & tapas of El Born
  • Crema Catalana & Xuixo
  • Cava & Priorat wines

Best time to visit Catalonia

Best time to visit Catalonia: Apr–Jun, Sep–Oct.
